metadata.description: Powch is DeSciX's identity and wallet: a passkey is the identity, keys derive in the browser, and every app reaches Powch as a cross-origin iframe. This marketplace carries the powch-specialist plugin, which answers Powch integration questions from the handbook and the powch knowledge base.

plugins.name: powch-specialist
plugins.description: Powch specialist: answers app developers' Powch integration questions (PowchClient on a standalone site, DeSciX.powch in the App Shell, the origin model, sign-in request shapes, device login, consent and Site Pass) from the DeSciX handbook and the powch knowledge base over the DeSciX connector, quoting the section each answer comes from.
